changeset-claim-re-read

## ⚠️ 1 pending changeset(s) describe a file this change touches

Their bodies publish **verbatim** into the CHANGELOG at the next release, so this is a request to **re-read them against your diff** — addressed here because you are the one seat that can answer it without re-deriving anything.

⛔ Nothing here blocks, and nothing here is a verdict on your change. This gate exits 0, is not a required context, and judges **name resolution, never meaning**: it asked whether a pending body names a file you touched. "Is this sentence still true?" is the one question it will not answer, and the one you are being asked to answer.

### `.changeset/7155-converge-lookup-dialect-camelcase.md`

- names `content/docs/fields/lookup.mdx` → `content/docs/fields/lookup.mdx` — edited by this change

  > Also moved with the rename: `content/docs/fields/lookup.mdx` and `user.mdx` (whose snippets CI compiles against the built `d.ts`), all seven in-repo producers, and the inline-edit enrichment allow-list in `@object-ui/plugin-detail`. `plugin-grid`'s `relationalMetaKeys.ts` drops the four `legacy-alias` verdicts and retires that verdict class; its gate is restated to assert the class no longer exists rather than passing vacuously.

Read the **paragraph**, not the line: both false halves of the objectui#8617 claim sat in one paragraph, and correcting either alone would have left it asserting the same wrong thing.

If a claim did go false, **correct the body**. That is precedented and prose-only, frontmatter untouched; `check-changeset-overwrite.mjs` will report the correction as its own case 2 ("correcting a declaration on purpose … legitimate"), which is the intended shape — one gate asks for the read, the other records the write.

Not covered, stated so nobody reads this as more: a born-false claim that spells no line address at all (objectui#9495 coordinated one by ORDINAL — "a grep finds that member first" — and deciding that means reading what the sentence means), a claim spelled as a symbol or a package rather than a backticked file name, and a file named ambiguously.

Compared the checked-out tree with `f308a655b` (merge-base with origin/main): 3 file(s) changed outside `.changeset/`, read against 1575 pending declaration(s) that publish a body (2163 pending in total). · [run](https://github.com/objectstack-ai/objectui/actions/runs/36300666663)

## Contract review

Served-tier: `CONTRACT_REVIEW_TIER`
Head-sha: `08be3d77080e722d9fff9524b947fabc43630c05`

### ① Derived judgments

**Premise re-measured.** REST `/issues/N` for the ten (5793, 6943, 7627, 7638, 7753, 8057, 7878, 7791, 7014, 9230): all 404; HTML pages also 404 (7014 probed). Controls 7013, 7015, 9229, 7790 answer 200. Landing PRs 7637 and 7805 answer 404; 7409, 7648, 9238, 8105, 7796, 6076, 7510, 9258 answer 200. So the "commits, not PRs" choice is forced, not stylistic.

**The ten commits.** Every sha resolves, is an ancestor of `refs/review/main` (25c7d584e4) by `merge-base --is-ancestor`, is unique at 9 chars (`rev-parse --short=9` returns 9 for each), and answers 200 both at `/repos/.../commits/sha` and at the HTML `/commit/sha` page. Per site, subject and diff read:

- 6943 → `6aeba673c` (PR 7409): adds `check-published-tsconfig-tooling-exclude.mjs`; its message names objectui#4006, #4836, #6943 as the three published-dist incidents. "all three recorded in `6aeba673c`, the commit that landed this gate" is true. #4006 and #4836 stay linked and answer 200.
- 7627 → `b041b9c0c` (PR 7637): "Fixes #7627"; publishes `resolveRecordSourceObjectName`, `useSettledSchema` docblock stops prescribing the ladder.
- 7638 → `2ce2612df` (PR 7648): message does not name 7638, but the diff carries `.changeset/7638-navigation-url-follows-record-source.md` and three `*-7638.test.*` files, and rewrites the hook's `@example` to `resolveRecordSourceObjectName` (7 occurrences). It is 7638's landing commit; "both cards closed by pointing the prose at `resolveRecordSourceObjectName` (`b041b9c0c`, `2ce2612df`)" is true of both.
- 7753 → `72498f257` (PR 7805): subject names objectui#7753; adds `check-handler-key-read-sites.mjs`, edits this very doc row; its message records the SUBSTITUTION holding `RUNTIME_SLOT` at 44 and `ALL_SITES` at 66, which is the count-ratchet-would-be-green reasoning the sentence describes. Attribution moves from the card to the commit whose message records the same reasoning; the claim itself is unchanged.
- 8057 → `9662aca56` (PR 9238): message: "objectui#8057 then reproduced the identical defect on a third writer in that card's own required dogfood, and a sweep found nine more"; adds `check-object-metadata-write-doors.mjs`, so "the commit that landed this gate" is true. "That card" is #7714, linked in the preceding sentence, 200.
- 7878 → `59a3a233d` (PR 8105): subject names objectui#7878; widens the census, edits this doc line.
- 7791 → `223b1e4a3` (PR 7796): subject names objectui#7791; the diff's test-file header carries "7 passed from the repo root, 2 failed / 5 passed from the package", the sentence's exact figures.
- 5793 → `111741454` (PR 6076): `.changeset/5793-spec-range-floors.md`, adds `check-spec-range-floors.mjs` and its workflow, and bumps `packages/plugin-detail/package.json` `@objectstack/spec` `^17.0.0` to `^17.1.0`. "repaired in the gate's own landing commit" is true.
- 7014 → `0e3b3be09` (PR 7510): `.changeset/7014-select-option-spec-claim-correction.md`, so it is 7014's landing commit. `git blame` at base attributes all four lines of the sentence to `e1545cfe6` (PR 7994, settles #7537), whose message says the page "carries the same attribution PR #7510 gave". Claim unchanged and true of that commit's measurement (spec 17.2.0). The claim is false of the installed spec today; see ③.
- 9230 → `20b507aff` (PR 9258): subject names objectui#9230; wrote this `select.mdx` section (+16 lines).

**Two prose re-points.** "in the second card's body" follows "measured at two cards and three copied call sites" in the same sentence, so "the second card" resolves. "the file that third writer lives in" refers back to "a THIRD writer neither guard covered" one sentence earlier; it is referenced, not named by file (the PR body's "named two sentences earlier" overstates), and the old wording named no file either. Both claims unchanged.

**Nothing lychee-visible still 404s.** The three head files carry 171 distinct objectui issue/pull links; the swept tree (`content/**`, `docs/**`, `README.md`, `skills/**`) carries 181 distinct numbers in 14 files (main: 191 in 14; the difference is the ten). REST on all 181: 181 answer 200. No bare `#N` prose mention of the ten remains in the three files. Lychee 0.18.1 (the dev's binary), repo `lychee.toml`, three head files exported to scratch: 185 total, 182 OK, 3 errors, exit 2; the 3 are `git-cliff.org` (proxy TLS), `github.com/lycheeverse/lychee` and `github.com/changesets/changesets` (proxy 403), none an objectui link. Objectui-scoped: 185 total, 173 OK, 0 errors, 12 excluded, exit 0. Tree-wide objectui-scoped: 530 total, 188 OK, 0 errors, 342 excluded, exit 0. All match the PR body's figures. Note the new citations are bare backticked shas, which lychee never reads (and `lychee.toml` excludes `/commit/` URLs anyway): the sweep proves the dead links are gone; the new pointers' liveness rests on ancestry of `main`, which holds.

**Published text.** Word-level diff shows only the citation spans and the two re-points move; every changed sentence judged above. Frontmatter md5 (lines 1 to 4 and the whole block) identical base to head: `6ca230b6b64dac22a2031d21ff311b13`, `289a5c887fd231f6b0b0824f53769fad`, `bae97ed7e436e0a06b8a154242ec15f1`. PR body spot checks: "five of six existing sha citations are 9 chars" true (`71be244d52` is the 10); "+6/−6, 3 files" true; H4 "191 numbers, 14 files" true; `abdcd189c` line 29 does name PR 7648 as removing the spelling 7638 was filed about; serial claims hold (below).

### ② Semver level

None. `content/**` only. `check-changeset-presence.mjs` `isPublishedSource` counts a path only as `pkg/src/`, `pkg/index.html`, or a `files`-listed entry of a `fixed`-group package; `content/` is under no package and `@object-ui/site` is in `ignore`. No changeset owed; "Changeset Declaration" is green on the head.

### ③ Boundary flags

- **CI on head:** 39 check runs, 36 success, 3 skipped by design (`Test (coverage)`, coverage shard, `dependabot`). `check-links` runs on `schedule` and `workflow_dispatch` only (`.github/workflows/check-links.yml`), so it is not among them and no PR can show the red-then-green; a `workflow_dispatch` after merge is the only instrument.
- **Merge:** `git merge-tree --write-tree refs/review/pr-10766 refs/review/main` (main now 25c7d584e4, four commits past base 704e05b09d) exits 0; the three files are untouched on main since base.
- **Open PRs:** 9 others open; none touches the three files.
- **Governed:** `check-governed-queue-guard.mjs --test` on the three paths: NOT GOVERNED (0 of 5 surfaces).
- **Draft and assignee:** draft is correct: AGENTS.md exception ② holds a dispatched PR at draft for the dispatch seat to flip ready and queue. PR has no assignee; the card has `os-elon-musk`. `os-dev.md` rule 2 says the dev never writes the assignee, so the refused write was outside the dev's contract and its refusal costs nothing; the PR assignee is the dispatch seat's field.
- **Out-of-scope finding, confirmed by my own measurement** on the installed `@objectstack/spec` 17.4.0 (`/home/user/objectui-issue-10712/node_modules`, `./data` export): `SelectOptionSchema` keys are `color, default, description, label, value, visibleWhen`; an option with `description` is ACCEPTED; a select `FieldSchema` carrying it is ACCEPTED; the `icon` control is REFUSED with `unrecognized_keys`. So `lookup.mdx` lines 68 to 76 ("strict over exactly {label, value, color, default, visibleWhen}", "refuses `description` by name", "fails the whole field with a 422", "must never reach authored object metadata") misstate the installed schema. Pre-existing: `544ecba84f` (PR 9588, 2026-09-16) corrected the five shipped docblocks and left this page, and its card #7635 now answers 404. It is a paragraph rewrite, outside a citations-only order, so follow-up, not this PR; but no card exists yet (147 open issues scanned; only #10755 mentions `lookup.mdx`), so the dispatch seat owes one before accepting. The kept citation is defensible under the triage ("cite the landing commit"), and it now dates the claim to the 17.2.0 measurement, which is the most a citation can do for a sentence that says "installed".
- **Nit, not blocking:** the PR body's "The third writer is named two sentences earlier" should read "referenced two sentences earlier"; the doc never names the file.

Implemented-by: `claude/issue-10755-dead-issue-citations`
Reviewed-by: `session_014mXUNuFomfj24w7s1pZzhN`

**VERDICT: PASS**
